# Yellow Wood Guiding

> > Private naturalist-guided tours of Rocky Mountain National Park and Estes Park, Colorado, specializing in wildlife viewing, photography instruction, hiking, and snowshoeing experiences.

Yellow Wood Guiding offers year-round guided tours led by naturalist Jared Gricoskie, focusing on wildlife encounters (elk, bighorn sheep, moose, bears), landscape photography, and seasonal experiences including the elk rut, snowshoeing, and alpine tundra exploration along Trail Ridge Road and Bear Lake.

## Key Topics

- Rocky Mountain National Park
- Estes Park
- Wildlife tours and viewing
- Photography tours and instruction
- Elk rut (September-October)
- Bighorn sheep
- Snowshoeing tours
- Trail Ridge Road
- Bear Lake and Bear Lake Area
- Naturalist-guided experiences
- Private tours
- Seasonal wildlife viewing
- Landscape photography
- Winter tours
- Timed entry permits

## Core Tour Offerings

- [Private Estes Park Tours of Rocky Mountain National Park](https://ywguiding.com): Yellow Wood Guiding homepage: wildlife, photo, hiking & snowshoeing tours
- [Estes Park Photo Tours in Rocky Mountain National Park](https://ywguiding.com/photo_safari_guided_tours.html): Private photo tours & photography lessons in Rocky Mountain National Park
- [Estes Park Nature Tours | Best of Rocky Mountain National Park Tours](https://ywguiding.com/estes-park-tours.html): Best of Rocky tours: Bear Lake, Trail Ridge Road & alpine tundra
- [Estes Park Elk Rut Tours of Rocky Mountain National Park](https://ywguiding.com/elk_rut_safari_estes_park.html): September-October elk rut tours: wildlife behavior & photography
- [Estes Park Snowshoe Tours | Rocky Mountain National Park Snowshoeing Tours](https://ywguiding.com/estes-park-snowshoeing.html): Guided snowshoeing tours to Dream Lake & Rocky Mountain National Park

## Seasonal Tours & Wildlife

- [Estes Park Winter Wildlife Tours of Rocky Mountain National Park](https://ywguiding.com/winter_wildlife_estes_park_tour.html): Winter wildlife tours: elk, bighorn sheep viewing in Rocky Mountain NP
- [Estes Park Winter Tours | Rocky Mountain National Park Winter Tours](https://ywguiding.com/winter-rocky-mountain-national-park-tours.html): Winter nature tours: frozen lakes, Bear Lake & wildlife ecology
- [Spring Photos | Private Estes Park Photo Tours](https://ywguiding.com/spring-estes-park-photo-tours.html): Spring photography opportunities: bighorn sheep, moose & wildflowers
- [Summer Estes Park Photo Tours | Rocky Mountain National Park Photo Tours](https://ywguiding.com/summer-estes-park-photo-tours.html): Summer photo ops on Trail Ridge Road: sunrise, landscapes & wildlife
- [Fall Photos | Private Estes Park Photo Tours](https://ywguiding.com/Fall-estes-park-photo-tours.html): Fall photography: elk rut, aspen colors & autumn landscapes
- [Estes Park Wildlife Tours | Chances of Seeing Wildlife](https://ywguiding.com/wildlife-chances.html): Wildlife viewing probability guide for bears, moose, elk & bighorn sheep
